tools.name: maroo_discover
tools.description: Get an adaptive overview of Maroo Network. Call this FIRST in any conversation about Maroo. The response adapts based on what you have already explored — it will suggest different next steps depending on session state.

tools.name: maroo_kb_search
tools.description: Search the Maroo knowledge base (100+ entries). Use this FIRST when you need to understand any Maroo concept, API, or workflow. Returns ranked results with IDs you can pass to maroo_kb_lookup for full content.

tools.name: maroo_kb_lookup
tools.description: Get the full content of a specific knowledge base entry by ID. Use after maroo_kb_search to read complete documentation for a concept, API, or guide.

id.description: Entry ID (from maroo_kb_search results or docs://maroo/ resource URIs)

tools.name: maroo_chain_info
tools.description: Get current Maroo chain status: block height, gas price, network name, RPC URL, and explorer link. Use this to verify chain connectivity or include network context in responses.

tools.name: maroo_wallet_create
tools.description: Create a new Maroo wallet. Generates a random private key and encrypts it with AES-256-GCM at ~/.maroo/keystore/. The passphrase is needed for signing transactions. NEVER share or log the passphrase.

passphrase.description: Encryption passphrase (min 8 chars). Used to encrypt the private key at rest.

tools.name: maroo_wallet_import
tools.description: Import an existing private key into the Maroo keystore. Encrypts with AES-256-GCM. Use this if you already have a wallet from another source.

tools.name: maroo_balance
tools.description: Read the OKRW balance for any Maroo address. When the session has a wallet loaded the `address` argument is optional. Also returns the address's on-chain PCL periodic-volume snapshot ({amount, maxAmount, remaining}) and the off-chain daily-spending tracker so the caller has the full "how much can I move?" picture in one round trip.

address.description: Address to query (defaults to the session wallet).

tools.name: maroo_preflight
tools.description: Pre-check a transfer BEFORE sending. Validates local policy limits, PCL compliance (denylist, volume, KYC), and sufficient balance. ALWAYS call this before maroo_send for Regulated Path transfers. Returns detailed pass/fail for each check with recovery strategies.

tools.name: maroo_pcl_check
tools.description: Compliance preview against the PCL precompile. Reads the sender's current periodic volume and computes whether adding `value` would exceed the per-address cap. No state changes — pure read via eth_call. Use this before `maroo_send` to avoid hitting an ante-handler reject mid-transaction. The companion tool `maroo_pcl_limits` returns the raw volume struct without the projection math.

sender.description: Sender address — the wallet whose periodic volume is checked

value.description: OKRW amount as decimal string (e.g. "500" or "0.5")

tools.name: maroo_pcl_limits
tools.description: Read the PCL periodic volume limit for an address. Returns `{ amount, maxAmount, remaining }` as decimal OKRW strings — `amount` is what the address has already moved this period, `maxAmount` is the cap, `remaining` is the headroom. Use this to surface "you have N OKRW left until reset" UIs, or to plan a transfer split. For "would THIS specific transfer pass?" use `maroo_pcl_check`.

address.description: Address to query (defaults to the session wallet). 40 hex chars, 0x-prefixed.

tools.name: maroo_send
tools.description: Send OKRW to an address. Automatically runs preflight checks (local policy + PCL + balance) as a safety net before signing. Requires wallet passphrase for signing. For Regulated Path transfers, call maroo_preflight first to preview checks.

passphrase.description: Keystore passphrase to decrypt private key for signing

tools.name: maroo_tx_status
tools.description: Get transaction receipt by hash. Returns status (success/reverted), block number, gas used, and logs. Use after maroo_send to confirm a transaction landed.
